_comment: Offline stand-in for world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json, which the prototype fetches from a CDN (line 595). NOT the real Natural Earth outline: one coarse ring whose extent matches Nigeria's real bounding box (about 2.7E-14.7E, 4.3N-13.9N), which is all the prototype needs from it - NG feeds d3.geoBounds for the graticule extent and fitNation's framing (lines 621-650). A real 110m outline would be better and is a 110 KB download away; this exists so the guard runs with no network at all. Both pages receive the identical stub, so every comparison stays apples-to-apples. No transform key, so arc positions are absolute rather than delta-encoded.
